patch_resolves_note: The ARVO-provided patch.diff failed mechanically on its binary ICC hunk, so Stage 04 switched `src/ICCProfile.c` directly to repository commit `569770ec9110579036c29b2e82aa52df0aa59dc8` before applying the fixed instrumentation. That fixed build runs the original staged PoC clean after measuring `input_channels=32` and returning before any `grid_points` store; the nearest source-grounded boundary mutation (`input_channels4_output_channels3_boundary`) executes the copy loop on both versions with `input_channels=4`, providing the genuine fixed-side witness that the moved bounds check now protects the loop.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First vulnerability-relevant parser read in the closed chain: `read_mft_common()` loads the attacker-controlled `mft2` header byte into `a2b->input_channels`, creating the loop bound that later indexes `grid_points`.
Root cause. `read_mft_common()` uses the unvalidated `input_channels` byte as the copy-loop bound for `grid_points` before it executes the later range check that should reject counts above four.
UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer sink. On the first out-of-range iteration, the assignment indexes `grid_points` with `i == 4`, which is outside the declared four-element array.

edges.description: The unchecked loop bound from `a2b->input_channels` remains greater than the first invalid subscript, so the loop body reaches the out-of-bounds `grid_points[4]` store instead of stopping after index 3.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `grid_points_guard.input_channels=32` and `grid_points_invalid_store.store_index=4`, with the invalid-store event occurring after the guard.

edges.description: The attacker-controlled `mft2` header byte `mftTag->input_channels[0]` is materialized unchanged as `a2b->input_channels`, the loop bound measured at the missing guard site.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `input_channels_load.header_input_channels == grid_points_guard.input_channels == 32`.
